integration.notes: After all update(dt) calls, render once through any support effect in this scene, replacing renderer.render. The required shared three-scale glow preserves the original palette and 14 layer types: full-resolution scenes, half/quarter/eighth-size halos; display scene alone uses 4x MSAA. No external textures or gameplay logic. size/speed are the only appearance controls. Lightning endpoints use group-parent coordinates; reapply after changing size. See bilingual guide.
